finding: Phi=0 occurs ONLY among hub-touched states in this fresh sample (0/total for no_hub_touch across all ell) -- consistent with Phi=0 requiring hub completion. However, NOT all hub-touched states reach Phi=0: a small number (3,1,1,1,1 = 7 total out of 300 hub-touched states) have Phi=ell+1 instead. This REFINES Round 15s claim ("all 212 hub-completed historical-corpus witnesses have Phi=0") -- that claim is corpus-exact for the historical (incomplete) corpus, and overwhelmingly (98%) but not universally true in this fresh, more complete recomputation. hub-completion is necessary but not quite sufficient for Phi=0 in general.
